notes.title: Important Notice
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903171/563246de99656196c8c08cb650272c10c7f4d17b.png
We are excited to announce that the full release of our game is approaching! Currently, you can already experience the Open Beta version and get an exclusive preview.

To access the Beta, follow these steps: right-click on the game in your library, go to "Properties," select "Beta," and choose the open beta.

About the Development
Our lead programmer underwent a significant change in his personal life and had to leave the project. Due to this, we had to reduce the scope of the game to prevent it from staying in early access indefinitely.

The game was reworked by a less experienced programmer in Unity. Despite this, we hope you enjoy the result as we have done our best given the circumstances. We are open to criticism and suggestions.

Thank you for your attention!

Translated by ChatGPT
